About Reading Games for Adults

A set of free reading games for adults who are learning to read English. They start with letters and sounds, then move to sight words, picture words and the signs, notices, messages and forms that adults meet every day. The tone is respectful and the screens are simple, with audio support, so learners with little reading can use them on their own. Everything opens straight away in the browser. There is no sign up, no account and no advertising.

How to use it

  1. Press the button and choose a reading game.
  2. Listen to the question, or read it.
  3. Tap the answer.
  4. Play again, or pick the next game.

Use it in a class

Open the Teacher Game and choose a reading game. Students join on their phones with the room code or QR code, and the projector shows the question to the whole class. Test Yourself: Reading gives a quick check of where each student is.
